caribbean.headline: Caribbean Storm Hits Martinique
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique is experiencing 100% rain probability with winds of 13 kt and wave heights of 2.7 ft, while nearby St. Lucia has a less intense system with winds of 11 kt. I expect these conditions to persist throughout the day, with the dominant swell direction remaining ESE and swell period of 6 s, affecting maritime activities in the region.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Winds Rise
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 24 kt winds with 6.7 ft wave heights and less than 10% rain probability, while neighboring ports like Dubrovnik see significantly calmer conditions with 8 kt winds. I expect the stronger winds in Mykonos to dominate the regional weather story, with swells coming from the SW direction and a short swell period of 6 s.
